Executive Assistant to the MD / CEO Job at Maurice Xandra Solutions Limited




        
    

        
        Maurice Xandra Solutions Limited - Our client, a gaming company, is recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Executive Assistant to the MD / CEO

Job Location: Lagos

Job Summary
     

            
    




	Our client is seeking a highly organized, strategic, and proactive Executive Assistant to support the Managing Director/CEO in a fast-paced, multi-business environment.
	The ideal candidate will manage executive operations, coordinate board-level activities, oversee complex schedules, support strategic initiatives, and maintain absolute confidentiality. Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills are essential, alongside proficiency in Microsoft Office tools and modern AI productivity platforms.


Key Responsibilities


	Executive and strategic support to the MD/CEO.
	Board meeting coordination, preparation of board packs, minutes, and follow-up on action items.
	Calendar, travel, and time management.
	Meeting coordination and executive reporting.
	Data analysis, dashboard management, and executive presentations.
	Stakeholder engagement and communication.
	Administrative and operational support.
	Leveraging AI tools to improve workflow efficiency.


Requirements


	MBA from a recognized institution is required.
	Proven experience as an Executive Assistant supporting a Managing Director/CEO (experience supporting Partners, Directors, or other executives alone will not be considered).
	Demonstrable board support experience, including coordinating board meetings and preparing board documentation.
	Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.
	Strong organizational, multitasking, and project coordination skills.
	Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
	High level of discretion, professionalism, and integrity.
	Experience using AI productivity tools to improve executive workflows.


Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should forward their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

Administrative & Consulting Support Officer Job at Don Quester Consulting




        
    

        
        Don Quester Consulting is a Management Consulting Organization. We offer bespoke interventions focused on significantly improving individual effectiveness and organizational performance. Our customized solutions are focused on helping individuals, organizations and communities realize their potentials and express new possibilities.

We are  recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Administrative & Consulting Support Officer 

Application Code: ACSO-01
Job Location: Ikeja, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time (Entry Level)

Job Summary
     

            
    




	Don Quester Consulting is seeking a highly organized and driven Administrative & Consulting Support Officer (Entry Level) for a full-time role.
	The successful candidate will support daily administrative operations while assisting with consulting projects and client engagements. This role is ideal for a motivated individual looking to build a career in consulting and professional services.


Key Responsibilities


	Provide full-time administrative support across consulting projects and internal operations
	Assist in preparing proposals, reports, presentations, and training materials
	Coordinate meetings, training sessions, workshops, and client engagements
	Manage schedules, records, correspondence, and documentation
	Support research, data gathering, and basic analysis for consulting assignments
	Liaise professionally with clients, vendors, and internal team members
	Ensure accurate filing and documentation of consulting and administrative records.


Requirements


	0–1 year of experience (internship or NYSC experience acceptable) with BSc. in Business Administration, Management, HR, Social Sciences, or related field
	Strong written and verbal communication skills
	Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
	Good attention to detail, multitasking ability and willingness to learn and grow in a consulting environment.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should forward their CV and a cover letter to: [email protected] using "ACSO-01" as the subject of the email.

We are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: Qualified Accountant

Job Location: Lagos

About the Role


	As a Qualified Accountant, reporting to the General Manager (Finance and Accounts), you will play a crucial role in managing and overseeing the company&#39;s financial records and reporting.
	You will be responsible for ensuring accuracy, compliance, and providing valuable insights to support strategic decision-making.


Key Responsibilities


	Overseeing and managing the day-to-day accounting operations.
	Preparing and analyzing financial statements (e.g., balance sheet, income statement, cash flow statement) in our countries of operation.
	Ensuring compliance with relevant accounting standards (e.g., IFRS) and local standards in our countries of operation.
	Managing the general ledger and ensuring its accuracy.
	Preparing and filing tax returns and ensuring tax compliance in our countries of operation.
	Developing and implementing accounting policies and procedures.
	Conducting internal audits and ensuring adherence to internal controls in our countries of operation.
	Reconciling bank accounts and other financial recordsin our countries of operation.
	Preparing and analyzing group budgets and forecasts.
	Providing financial analysis and reporting to management.
	Liaising with external auditors and regulatory authorities in our countries of operation.
	Developing, mentoring and supervising junior accounting staff.
	Contributing to the continuous improvement of accounting processes.
	Performing other accounting duties as assigned.


Qualifications and Experience


	Bachelor&#39;s Degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field. A Master&#39;s degree in Business, Accounting or Finance will be an advantage.
	Maximum of 8 years of progressive accounting training and experience, preferably from any of the global big four accounting firms, a Free Zone environment or a similar industry.
	Professional accounting certification (e.g., ACA, ACCA, CPA) is mandatory.
	Strong knowledge of accounting principles, practices, and regulations (including IFRS).
	Proven experience in preparing and analyzing financial statements.
	Excellent understanding of tax laws and compliance requirements in Nigeria and /or Ghana.
	Proficiency in accounting software and ERP systems (e.g., Microsoft Dynamics, Sage, QuickBooks).
	Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and other MS Office Suite applications.
	Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
	Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
	Strong communication (both written and verbal) and interpersonal skills.
	Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
	Strong organizational and time-management skills with the ability to meet deadlines.


What We Offer


	A competitive salary and benefits package.
	Opportunities for professional growth and development.
	A dynamic and supportive work environment within the Lekki Free Zone.
	The chance to contribute to the success of a growing organization in the agriculture, manufacturing and distribution industries.


Method of Application&nbsp;

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Qualified Accountant

Job Location: Lagos

About the Role
     

            
    




	As a Qualified Accountant, reporting to the General Manager (Finance and Accounts), you will play a crucial role in managing and overseeing the company's financial records and reporting.
	You will be responsible for ensuring accuracy, compliance, and providing valuable insights to support strategic decision-making.


Key Responsibilities


	Overseeing and managing the day-to-day accounting operations.
	Preparing and analyzing financial statements (e.g., balance sheet, income statement, cash flow statement) in our countries of operation.
	Ensuring compliance with relevant accounting standards (e.g., IFRS) and local standards in our countries of operation.
	Managing the general ledger and ensuring its accuracy.
	Preparing and filing tax returns and ensuring tax compliance in our countries of operation.
	Developing and implementing accounting policies and procedures.
	Conducting internal audits and ensuring adherence to internal controls in our countries of operation.
	Reconciling bank accounts and other financial recordsin our countries of operation.
	Preparing and analyzing group budgets and forecasts.
	Providing financial analysis and reporting to management.
	Liaising with external auditors and regulatory authorities in our countries of operation.
	Developing, mentoring and supervising junior accounting staff.
	Contributing to the continuous improvement of accounting processes.
	Performing other accounting duties as assigned.


Qualifications and Experience


	Bachelor's Degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field. A Master's degree in Business, Accounting or Finance will be an advantage.
	Maximum of 8 years of progressive accounting training and experience, preferably from any of the global big four accounting firms, a Free Zone environment or a similar industry.
	Professional accounting certification (e.g., ACA, ACCA, CPA) is mandatory.
	Strong knowledge of accounting principles, practices, and regulations (including IFRS).
	Proven experience in preparing and analyzing financial statements.
	Excellent understanding of tax laws and compliance requirements in Nigeria and /or Ghana.
	Proficiency in accounting software and ERP systems (e.g., Microsoft Dynamics, Sage, QuickBooks).
	Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and other MS Office Suite applications.
	Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
	Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
	Strong communication (both written and verbal) and interpersonal skills.
	Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
	Strong organizational and time-management skills with the ability to meet deadlines.


What We Offer


	A competitive salary and benefits package.
	Opportunities for professional growth and development.
	A dynamic and supportive work environment within the Lekki Free Zone.
	The chance to contribute to the success of a growing organization in the agriculture, manufacturing and distribution industries.
